fields.statement: How should the daemon reap its finished run drivers? (Fix The daemon never reaps its, 01M6Q3X1.) The intent proposes a periodic wait4(-1, WNOHANG), but the daemon also runs git, make and hook commands through os/exec, some concurrently from web UI request goroutines; wait4(-1) can reap one of those first, so its cmd.Wait/Output fails with 'no child processes'. Detached drivers are the only children started with Setsid, so they lead their own session.
